results.name: Top endpoint previews shared lanes, fixes end and performs no write until release
Bottom endpoint extends and shrinks duration while start remains fixed
Endpoint crossing clamps at one inclusive day, and a click without movement does not save
Escape, pointer cancellation and focus loss cancel preview without modifying work
Month auto scroll follows an endpoint and commits only on release
Clipped endpoints remain visible and quick actions remain available
Keyboard endpoints work across year boundaries while preserving the opposite date
Failed autosave preserves resized preview and retry saves its fixed-opposite interval
Manual mode can discard resize, and zoomed date rows retain exact end adjustment
Ten narrow parallel works have independent bottom handles and retain readable feedback
Touch bottom resize works on mobile, and reduced-motion preference disables the landing animation
